finding.reason: Scoped temporary-file integration tests exercise the Node filesystem byte reads, UTF-8 and missing-file failures, and native lstat metadata used by the private-file ownership predicate. Negative ownership, link-count, mode and file-type cases deliberately modify that metadata in memory. Replacing the entire suite with MemoryFileSystem would remove the native-provider integration witness. NodeServices is supplied through one explicit it.layer; no manual runtime execution is used. Owner: agent-observability-foundation / @beep/repo-ai-metrics. Exit: retire this occurrence when pure predicate cases are separated and the remaining native integration uses a detector-recognized explicit filesystem layer, or when this native-provider witness is intentionally retired. Independent Astra panel reviewed this exact occurrence on 2026-10-29.
